assessment_scope.source_boundary: Only the subject's one curated REVIEWED item at basis_commit, read end to end with its front matter: the canonical character monograph series/fx-fighter-kurumi-chan/characters/fukuga-ikuo-manga.md (FXK-P002, version 1.1, 74,423 bytes, status canonical, empty supersession arrays, veto false), a self-contained portrait of Fukuga Kurumi's father within the Japanese collected manga main narrative V01-V10 to V10 i0156 (24 April 2017), located by volume and page occurrence (Vnn iNNNN) and by the project's observation, decision, claim, forecast and open-question IDs, with brief Japanese quotations. The surname 福賀 is printed for him; the given name 郁夫 (Ikuo) is the project's INFERENCE HIGH identification, never printed in a scene of his own. He is shown only from outside: no thought balloon or inner caption of his appears, and his interior is reached through his own spoken self-accounts (above all V09 i0072-i0073 and i0083-i0084), his wife Kozue's V06 account under mixed narrative authority, Kurumi's memories and narration, and one narrator prediction (V08 i0035). Its publication note records an independent self-containment PASS and a fidelity PASS after revision; revision 1.1 changes only a transcription in the table of name forms. The volume readings, the decision and evidence ledger, Studies B and C, the audits and the other monographs it cites are not curated on this subject, and no claim rests on them directly. The project's COMPLETE_AT_BOUNDARY qualification outcome was not adopted as a grade. No primary source page was inspected for this assessment.
assessment_scope.temporal_boundary: His conduct as the page shows it from the 2008 posting to V09's early-2015 aftermath, in located states: before his wife's death (posted away in 2008; earlier transfers and the marriage's money roles known only from his V09 memory and her V06 account); April 2009 to May 2014 (commuting from home, the gentle FX warning, month-end saving, unaware of Kurumi's trading); the late-May 2014 discovery night (V02 i0021-i0038); November 2014 to January 2015 (transfer announced with an apology, departure, one unanswered call; unaware of her renewed trading, loss and debt); and the early-2015 confession night and settlement (V09 i0062-i0098, i0107, i0122-i0123). The V02 to V09 difference is a located change of stance between two states, not datable within the interval. V09's disclosures (the 300万 saved for her, the money roles of his marriage, his rebellious youth) are late revelations that belong to him at every earlier state they predate; they are not change. He is absent from V10 (April 2017). Nothing after V10 i0156 is evidence.
assessment_scope.assessment_method: characters/RECONSTRUCTION_CAPABILITY_SPEC.md and governance/policies/CHARACTER_RECONSTRUCTION_MAINTENANCE.md at basis_commit, applying the owner calibration rulings recorded there (B/C boundary, single counting of uncertainty, dialogue constrained-use test, chronology splits, relationship-transfer safeguards and control-state attribution) and the owner's A/B boundary direction of 24 November 2026 in PR #694, not yet recorded in the policy: A turns on the integration, individuation and transferability of the model within a declared scope; interpretations that predict the same behavior may coexist; divergent transfer conditions, missing evidence and unsettled dispositions are named and excluded rather than counted against the tier; held-out validation, analytical derivation, relationship labels and preserved source chronology are not barriers. Evidence-located calibration with countercases, explicit gaps and no model-readiness inheritance.

dimensions.note: Section 3 gives five recurring values with located instances (ordinary sufficiency over speculation, V01 i0039; being relied on, V02 i0027 and V09 i0073; process before outcome, V02 i0031; a parent's duty to say stop, V02 i0031 and V09 i0084; character over circumstance, V09 i0096-i0097), goals of her safety and the family's continuance, fear that she will repeat her mother (INFERENCE MODERATE-HIGH), and vulnerabilities including, by his own verdict, a manner that made confiding hard (V09 i0073). It predicts mistakes: absence at both crises, not checking on her between V02 and V09, the one slap. Not B: the monograph keeps four readings of the V02 to V09 difference live (development, a different answer to a different act, situational scale, narrative function) and states that the page does not decide between them, so it cannot say which account governs his response to a new wrong; it abstains on a discovered concealment after V09. That is insufficiency, not productive uncertainty. Not D: the values recur across volumes and support located conditional predictions.

Section 11 dates what holds (opposition to FX, wish to be relied on, process judgment, practical care, speech) and what changes between V02 (late May 2014) and V09 (early 2015): her adulthood denied then granted (V02 i0030-i0031; V09 i0083), demand and plea becoming a stance stated without enforcement (V02 i0031-i0032; V09 i0076-i0084), force absent in V09, his own share first voiced (V09 i0073). A slower work-against-family shift is traced (V09 i0072 memory; V01 i0038; V05 i0069; V09 i0123), and late revelations are kept apart from change. Not B: only two substantial states, nothing between them shows him reflecting, the change cannot be dated within the interval, and whether it is development is open. Not D: both states and the intervening traces are dated and contrasted with locators.

Section 6 gives individuated, multi-instance rules: plain masculine short speech (言わん, 扱いきれん, 食いながら); endings ぞ for warning and stance, な for settled statements, だろ for appeals; parental 〜なさい for command and generosity alike; 父さん as parent and 俺 for a stance, with a located shift inside one V09 scene (FXK-V09-E035); くるみ to his daughter and お前 to her only in anger (V02 i0030); concession then a firm clause as his most stable signature (V01 i0039; V09 i0073, i0083-i0084); confirming questions, 無理 verdicts, supplication when command fails, スマン apologies, emphasis dots in 親・と・し・て・な; and listener shifts (daughter at ease, under her boast, under her confession, her friends, a colleague, his wife in memory). The profile rates the conversational row HIGH. Not A: the lines come from a few scenes, almost all with his daughter; register with strangers or at work is barely sampled, and no interior speech exists to test inner against outer. Not C: the rules are located across V01, V02, V05, V07 and V09 and individuated enough to constrain written output.

Ordinary conduct is located: 'おかえり / ご飯は?' (V02 i0014); newspaper on the sofa or at the kotatsu (V09 i0070, i0122-i0123); souvenir manjū (V09 i0069); brief texts (V09 i0067); 'じゃあ行ってくる' and the reminder to lock up (V07 i0031); hamburg steak out with '好きなの頼みなさい' (V09 i0085, i0092); month-end cash saving by Kurumi's narration (V01 i0108-i0109); a stated preference for short business trips over long postings (V09 i0063). The monograph marks hobbies, leisure, drink, friends and life on his postings unknown. Not B: home-only and mostly single-scene; the dinner expectation rests on one line (INFERENCE MODERATE). Not D: several located habits across volumes and one stated preference.

Section 7 gives directed, dated states toward Kurumi from V01 to V10 (protection without knowledge; discovery; offstage presence; an apology for leaving; a routine farewell; one call; relief, self-blame, gift and a stance kept; absence), with knowledge states dated in section 2. Toward his wife, his memory and conduct (V09 i0072-i0073; V01 i0108) are kept apart from her mixed-authority V06 account. Her friends (V09 i0095-i0097) and a young colleague (V09 i0062-i0066) are one short scene each; he never meets Mochiko. Response conditioning is located: discovered concealment justified by success drew anger, force and pleading (V02), self-disclosure without excuse drew relief, self-blame and help (V09). Not B: almost every row rests on his daughter, and whether discovery versus disclosure or a change in him explains the difference is left open. Not D: the states are directed, dated and tied to what she discloses.

No thought balloon or inner caption of his appears in ten volumes. Interior positions come only from his spoken self-accounts (relief that she is alive and his wife's silence, V09 i0072; self-blame, '情けない話だ', V09 i0073; his youth and the parental stance, V09 i0083-i0084), from Kozue's views of him under V06's mixed authority, from Kurumi's surmise (replaced by his own V09 account of the 300万), and from one narrator prediction (V08 i0035). The monograph states that the difference between what he thinks and what he says cannot be tested. Not C: there is no interior access, only self-report in two scenes. Not E: those self-accounts are substantial and located, and his strain responses recur.

The one full escalation is sequenced in five located steps on the V02 night: an outside theft to report (i0022), relief that the culprit is family, accountability and a demand for reasons (i0025), a protective offer of help (i0027), then, after her outcome justification and claim to adulthood (i0029), one slap, お前, a process critique, a denial of her competence and adulthood, and a bowed plea (i0030-i0032). In V09 conflict shrinks to one frown and one sentence before he accepts her refusal of the vow (i0079-i0083). The comic menace toward his colleague is a gag (V09 i0065-i0066). Not B: one escalation, with the trigger of force (the boast rather than the taking) only INFERENCE MODERATE, and whether force is characteristic is undecidable from one slap; conflict with anyone but his daughter is unshown. Not D: the sequence and its triggers are located step by step.

Section 4 gives located priorities: life over money (V09 i0072), disclosure over obedience (accepting her refusal of a vow she could not be sure of keeping, V09 i0079-i0083), process over outcome (V02 i0031), and the one weighing of parental control against an adult child's autonomy, resolved by withdrawing the vow while keeping his stated opposition 親として (V09 i0083-i0084). The weighing is shown only from outside. Not C: one located weighing, with no deliberation shown from inside and no dilemma toward anyone outside the family. Not E: the priorities recur across the V02 and V09 scenes.

His humour is characterized as dry, brief and deadpan, with him as the straight man in the series' comic register: 'まさか こんな使い道になるとはな' over the 300万 (V09 i0075), '運がいいのか悪いのかわからないが…' over the takoyaki (V09 i0122), '父ですが… なにか?' to Kurumi's friends (V09 i0095), and the comic menace toward his colleague (V09 i0065-i0066). Not C: the instances are few and all in V09's aftermath, with no account of range. Not E: the monograph gives the style and its function, not only isolated lines.

One dedicated, independently reviewed portrait enumerates every present-time appearance and absence across V01-V10 (V01, V02, V05, V07, V08, V09 drawn; V03, V04, V06 mentioned only; V10 absent, with V10 i0151 an INFERENCE LOW allusion), routes each interpretation to page occurrences and accepted IDs (section 14), lists the pages re-opened for it, and keeps the evidence layers apart (his scenes, Kurumi's narration, Kozue's V06 account, the narrator). Not A: the row curates only this derived item; the readings and ledger behind it are not curated, and the source itself gives two concentrated scenes and traces. Not C: within the boundary its accounting of his appearances is complete and located.

Affirmative limits and contradictions are located: the V02 reading's forecast that he would check or restrict her trading was disconfirmed (FXK-V02-F030); the V10 expectation that he would appear was scored disconfirmed (V10-EN-9); the V08 reading's entering state was corrected (he knew of the 2014 trading, not the 2015 loss); Kurumi's surmise about the 300万 is replaced by his own account (V09 i0074); the vow was not stated as a condition of the money (FXK-V09-E032); his V02 'borrowed money' verdict and his V09 gift are reconciled as money to trade against money to end a debt; the slap is his only use of force; he never asks a figure; he is not shown learning of the letter or the plan (V09-U07); the wage arrangement is known only from Kurumi's report (V09 i0107). Not A: several limits are absences rather than contradictions. Not C: the disconfirmations and corrections are explicit and located.

States carry calendar placement: the 2008 posting, 13 February 2009, April 2009, May 2014, late May 2014, autumn 2014, November 2014, end of December 2014, January 2015, early 2015, February 2015, April 2017 absence; section 2 dates what he knew and when, and section 11 separates change from late revelation. Not A: several dates rest on Kurumi's hedged narration (V01 i0038, らしく), the pre-2009 transfers are undated memory, and the V02 to V09 change cannot be dated within its interval. Not C: the dated knowledge table and the dated state contrasts are explicit.

conditions: Output is illustrative written Japanese, never quotation; no performed voice is claimed, since the evidence is balloon text, ellipses and emphasis dots.

Interlocutor is Kurumi in a named state: at ease (practical care, affectionate brevity), under a discovered concealment she justifies by success (お前, imperatives, a verdict, then a plea; V02 state), or under her own disclosure (confirmation, a promise not to be angry, concession then a firm clause; V09 state).
Self-reference 父さん as parent and 俺 for a stance; plain masculine endings ぞ, な, だろ; 〜なさい for command or generosity; お前 to her only in anger.

Her friends (questions about their character and a maxim) and a junior colleague (reserve, then comic menace) are each one short scene; any other interlocutor is a separate, lower-confidence transfer limited to the register rules.
No interior monologue: he has no inner speech on the page.
scenario_readiness.note: The register rules constrain illustrative written Japanese closely enough for bounded use with his daughter in a named state; other interlocutors are thinly sampled and no performed voice is claimed.

conditions: After V09, Kurumi tells him openly that she wants to invest again: predict stated parental opposition, no force and support not withdrawn (the monograph's LOW-MODERATE bounded extrapolation; her refusal of the vow is the nearest test).

Kurumi discloses a wrong herself, without excuse: predict a confirming question, no anger, relief, a share of blame where his manner contributed, and practical help without a stated condition (V09; one long scene).
Work pulls him away from home: predict that he goes, apologizes and compensates by returning or rearranging (V01, V05, V09 traces).
Talk turns to money: he speaks in principles and roles, not figures, and does not ask the amount.
A discovered concealment after V09 is excluded: V02 is the only precedent and V09 differs from it in ways the evidence does not resolve; the monograph says to abstain.

Knowledge boundary: he knows the 2014 trading he discovered, the ruin and bankruptcy from her call, the debt only as '1億', and that it was 'ギリギリ'; he is not shown knowing of the V08 plan or the letter addressed to him.

cross_scenario_scope.assumed_chronology: One named state: April 2009 to May 2014 before discovery; the V02 discovery night; November 2014 to January 2015 posted away; or the V09 confession night and its 2015 aftermath. V09's late revelations (the 300万 saved for her, the money roles of his marriage, his youth) belong to him in every earlier state. Nothing after V10.
cross_scenario_scope.interlocutor_relationship: Kurumi, his adult daughter, as the person he protects, judges by process and wants to be relied on by. Her friends and a junior colleague are one short scene each; Mochiko, strangers and anyone else at fault are unsampled and are a separate, lower-confidence transfer if used at all.
setting_constraints: The Fukuga flat and family finances in Japan, 2009 to 2015, as the manga presents them, including his postings and her bankruptcy procedure.

No scene at his workplace or on his postings, no market trading by him, no romantic or intimate matter, no method of the V08 crisis, no event after V10, and no outcome invented to settle a prediction.

scenario_readiness.note: Narrow extrapolation is supported only where the monograph's profile gives a located precedent; the central novel case after V09, a discovered concealment or concealed return to the market, is excluded because the evidence cannot choose between its precedents.

conditions: Home routines with Kurumi: greetings and asking whether she has eaten, newspaper and tea, souvenirs from his posting, meals she cooks or a meal out, brief texts.
Meeting her friends: asks who they are and whether they are good people, sets aside how they met, commends friendship (one short scene).
Hobbies, leisure, drink, friends of his own and life on his postings are not modeled.
scenario_readiness.note: Ordinary home conduct with his daughter is located across volumes; her friends are one scene and his own social life is unknown.

The evidence gives priorities and one outward weighing of parental control against her autonomy, never a deliberation from inside or a dilemma toward others; ethical scenarios beyond the parental-duty frame that CROSS_SCENARIO covers would be invention.

The monograph marks attraction, romantic history, attachment style, jealousy, intimate boundaries and any relationship after 2009 UNTESTED; his marriage is seen only through Kozue's fantasy and his own memory of its money roles. Romance scenarios would rest on what the evidence declines to claim.

His occupation is never shown or named; the only work scene is a colleague driving him (V09 i0062-i0066), and the monograph lists his conduct at work and on his postings among the points to abstain on.

known_limits.statement: Most of the evidence rests on two scenes, the V02 discovery and the V09 confession and settlement; everything else is a trace, a memory or another person's view, and the monograph calls generalization beyond its conditional profile extrapolation.
No thought balloon or inner caption of his appears in ten volumes; the difference between what he thinks and what he says cannot be tested.

Four readings of the V02 to V09 difference stay live (development, a different answer to a different act, situational scale, narrative function), and the page does not decide between them; no page between V02 and V09 shows him reflecting.

His response to a discovered concealment or concealed return to the market after V09 cannot be chosen from the evidence: V02 is the only precedent for a discovered concealment, and V09 shows him answering differently in other respects.
Almost every profile row rests on scenes with his daughter; he is shown with a work colleague once, with her friends once, never with a stranger, and never with anyone but her at fault.
The V02 slap is his only use of physical force in ten volumes; whether it is characteristic or exceptional cannot be decided from one instance.
He is not shown learning of the V08 plan or the letter addressed to him, the exact debt figure, or Kurumi's renewed trading after V02.
The given name 郁夫 is an INFERENCE HIGH identification from Kozue's V06 account and his V09 memory; it is never printed in a scene of his own.
The management of Kurumi's wages after the bankruptcy is known only from her own report to Mochiko (V09 i0107), and whether it still held in April 2017 is not shown.
Hobbies, leisure, drink, friends of his own, his occupation, his age and his life on his postings are never shown.
The V01-V10 deep readings, the decision and evidence ledger, Studies B and C and the qualification and reconciliation audits are not curated on this subject; nothing here rests on them directly.
